headline: Biogen has a firm October 21 go-live. Regeneron moved one week to October 5 to finish its content audit, Corcept starts a one-week pilot September 28 ahead of an expected October 8 go-live, and Praxis targets the week of October 12.

biogen.name: Biogen
biogen.summary: Firm go-live October 21, with AI foundation training the week of Oct 19, then persona training.

ipsen.name: Ipsen
ipsen.summary: Preparing CMS content for the knowledge base; Matt Dugan leading.

regeneron.name: Regeneron
regeneron.summary: Moved one week to October 5 to finish content audit and testing.

corcept.name: Corcept Therapeutics
corcept.summary: One-week pilot starts September 28; go-live expected ~October 8.

praxis.name: Praxis Medicines
praxis.summary: FCRs working; very strong client feedback. Awaiting go-live confirmation.

philips.name: Philips Respironics
philips.summary: Live; team aligned on next steps for new content.

azurity.name: Azurity (Currax)
azurity.summary: Live and stable; cross-brand scoping in progress.
